rows.label: Home itself
rows.note: Home, the AI program that runs the models, and the space the install needs to build them.

rows.label: Chat AI (Qwen3 8B)
rows.note: The AI you talk to. A small starter chat AI (Qwen3 1.7B) comes first so you can talk while the big one downloads.

rows.label: Memory search model
rows.note: Finds what Home remembers when you ask.

rows.label: Speech to text
rows.note: Turns what you say into words, on this computer.

rows.label: Voice (Pocket TTS)
rows.note: Home's spoken voice.

rows.label: Edit pictures tools
rows.note: Remove a background, erase something, make a picture bigger.

rows.label: Look at pictures
rows.note: Name household objects, wall colour and light. Runs only when Home sends a picture.

rows.label: Split songs into stems (HTDemucs)
rows.note: Separates songs made in Home into vocals, drums, bass and other. Recommended, about 0.3 GB.

rows.label: Finer stem splitter (HTDemucs fine-tuned)
rows.note: An optional four model package for finer stem separation.

rows.label: Six-part stem splitter (guitar and piano)
rows.note: An optional model that separates guitar and piano too.

rows.label: Time song lyrics (MMS aligner)
rows.note: Finds when each word of a song's lyrics is sung, for the lyrics display. Optional, about 1.3 GB.

rows.label: Change the singing voice (SoulX-Singer)
rows.note: Converts a vocal toward a reference voice. Optional, about 3 GB.

rows.label: Recorded speech (Fish Audio Drama 3)
rows.note: Makes a finished voice recording from typed words, including dialogue. It also lets the Chatterbox voice whisper. Recommended with Chatterbox, about 24 GB; needs a 64 GB or larger computer. Skip it and the voice speaks normally when asked to whisper.

rows.label: Audio and video tools (ffmpeg)
rows.note: Cuts, mixes and changes sound and video. GPL 3 or later.

rows.label: Search helper
rows.note: Looks up web search results for adults, when web search is turned on.

rows.label: Python base for the engines
rows.note: The shared Python the voice and picture engines run on.

rows.label: Voice engine tools
rows.note: What the voice runs on.

rows.label: Picture editing engine tools
rows.note: What removing a background, erasing and enlarging run on.

rows.label: Stem splitting tools
rows.note: What separating song stems runs on.

rows.label: Lyric timing tools
rows.note: What timing a song's words runs on.

rows.label: Voice conversion tools
rows.note: What converting a singing voice runs on.

rows.label: Recorded speech tools
rows.note: What recorded speech rendering runs on.
